title: Confirmation run (fresh, different domain): all three modes
description: Written and committed BEFORE running, after the x01 fixes. Run ONCE; no product fixes are allowed in response. Different domain (payments) to check nothing is tuned to meetings. Natural phrasing.
objective: Choose a payments provider for the EU launch and list what blocks the choice.

lines.text: So, Stripe or Adyen for the EU launch?
Finance wants an answer by Friday.
Does Adyen support SEPA Direct Debit for subscriptions?
Their sales rep was very responsive, at least.
Sure, but that's not the product.
Does Stripe charge extra for Radar fraud screening?
Honestly no idea, would have to look.
Stripe takes about two days to pay out, I think.
What happens if we pick the wrong one and need to migrate later?
Yeah, that would hurt.
Is everyone okay with a quick break at eleven?
Works for me.
Does Adyen's API have a sandbox for testing payouts?
Yes, they have a full test environment, I used it last month.
Did Stripe raise their EU card fees this year?
Not sure. Let's check after the meeting.
Anyway, onboarding. Both need KYC documents from us.
Adyen's onboarding took a competitor six weeks.
Stripe was a few days for us at my last company.
The integration effort looks similar for both.
So which provider do we pick?
Where does that leave us then?

simulatedSearch.note: Simulated search results (test only), written with the answer key before running.

entries.answer: FIXTURE: Yes, SEPA Direct Debit is supported for recurring payments.
FIXTURE: Radar is included; Radar for Fraud Teams costs extra per screened transaction.
FIXTURE: Standard EU payout schedule is a few business days; varies by country.
FIXTURE: Yes, Adyen has a test environment.
FIXTURE: EU card pricing changed this year for some card types.
